meta.source: VYRAL homepage brief (Claude Design, variant A coral and gold) plus app mockup Option 1, Nov 2026

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: Page background, app and website.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the docked Analyst, table containers.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wash: selected sidebar item, chips, ghost buttons, tab tracks.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: The loop panel behind the three loop cards (Home brief, homepage hero).

tokens.name: band-tint
tokens.usage: Outer stop of light section gradients on the website; transition into dark bands.

tokens.name: band-dark
tokens.usage: Dark bands on the website (loop explained, compliance, closing CTA) and verdict cards in the app.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on base, surface and surface-soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body text where muted is too light, e.g. card descriptions.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, meta text. Passes 4.5:1 on base, surface and surface-soft.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on band-dark.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band-dark.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, panel borders.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, dashed placeholder pills, stronger dividers.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand coral: V mark, loop wires and arrowheads, active nav icon, tab underline, chart highlight bar. Not for button fills with white text on light (fails contrast).

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. White text passes on light; dark theme uses near-black text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-strong.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on primary buttons; link colour.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Gold, data only: second chart highlight, best-slot marker, dark-band labels and ticks. Never text on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Background of delta and stat pills (always paired with an arrow and a label).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text in delta and stat pills, on signal-soft.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Default bars in charts and sparklines.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero headline only. Max width 940px.
styles.sample: Your last post already told you what to write next

styles.name: numeral
